verdict.rationale: A government IP filing and services platform could plausibly offer background automations such as scheduled filings, auto-pay of maintenance fees, or status-change triggers, so the axis applies. The evidence shows none of these. The docketing and status-tracking features are user-initiated monitoring, not autonomous automation. The api.uspto.gov endpoint and the direct API calls to Workbench are developer building blocks rather than a first-party automation capability.
